case_title: WILLIAMS VICTORIA VS BUCKNER GEORGE C

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,087.40 FILED BY WILLIAMS VICTORIA AS TO DEFENDANT BUCKNER GEORGE C ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-07-1992 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 01
CERT. RECEIPT TO GEORGE BUCKNER RETURNED SIGNED.
